```gherkin
Feature: Self-Test

  Scenario: O2 Sensor Accuracy
    Given the O2 sensor is calibrated
    When the self-test is run
    Then the O2 sensor accuracy is within 10% of the expected value

  Scenario: Blower Response
    Given the blower speed is set to 50%
    When the self-test is run
    Then the pressure achieved at that speed is within 20% of the expected value

  Scenario: Pinch Valves Pressure Response
    Given the blower speed is set to 75%
    When the self-test is run
    Then the pinch valves pressure response is within 10% of the expected value

  Scenario: Audible Alarm Devices
    Given the audible alarm devices are connected
    When the self-test is run
    Then all audible alarm devices work as expected

  Scenario: Visual Alarm Devices
    Given the visual alarm devices are connected
    When the self-test is run
    Then all visual alarm devices work as expected

  Scenario Outline: Blower Speed Limits
    Given the blower speed is set to <blower_speed>
    When the self-test is run
    Then the system behaves as expected

    Examples:
      | blower_speed | expected_behavior |
      | 0%           | error              |
      | 25%          | warning             |
      | 50%          | normal              |
      | 75%          | normal              |
      | 100%         | error              |

  Scenario Outline: Sensor Accuracy Ranges
    Given the O2 sensor accuracy is <accuracy>
    When the self-test is run
    Then the system behaves as expected

    Examples:
      | accuracy | expected_behavior |
      | 5%       | error              |
      | 10%      | warning             |
      | 15%      | normal              |
      | 20%      | normal              |
      | 25%      | error              |

  Scenario Outline: Input Validation
    Given the input value is <input_value>
    When the self-test is run
    Then the system behaves as expected

    Examples:
      | input_value | expected_behavior |
      | normal      | normal             |
      | edge        | error              |
      | invalid     | error              |

  Scenario Outline: Error Handling
    Given the system is in an error state
    When the self-test is run
    Then the system behaves as expected

    Examples:
      | error_state | expected_behavior |
      | true        | error              |
      | false       | normal             |
```
